extraction.Name: Julia Weber
extraction.Refused/Protested: while she did not make application for the patent in fee to her 160 acre allotment when it was issued, April 13,1918, she was perfectly willing to accept it when it was sent to her; and has never regretted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: in 1923, she mortgaged her 160 acre allotment, together with her brother Frank and Joseph and her mother's 632.16 acre allotment, to the Federal Loan Association, of Omaha, Nebraska, for the sum of $7000.00
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to the Federal Loan Association, of Omaha, Nebraska, for the sum of $7000.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: she did not sell her land for any debts incurred prior to receiving her patent in fee; mortgage was to enable her father to purchase three sections more of land
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; health is good; single, has no one to support; has kept the taxes paid up on her allotment; has kept the interest paid up on the loan; expects to clear her part of the mortgage the coming fall, retaining her quarter clear in her own name; mortgage was made jointly with brothers Frank and Joseph and covered mother's 632.16 acre allotment as well; father purchased three sections of land in his name with mortgage proceeds; has never received any aid from the County, State nor the United States Government; document sworn April 2, 1929 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
